description:
Part of epic ag-o6z; read it first. Needs ag-o6z.1 (delivery index, outcome column).

## Goal

Every run of a live deployment appears in Agbredo, whether or not it asked for a telemetry token: skipped runs, runs that failed before the telemetry step, runs of disabled deployments. Today docs/10-design.md says "A run is registered only when a token is requested"; that changes.

## Where the code is

- internal/webapi/api.go, func webhook: parses only repository.full_name and workflow_run.id.
- internal/core/worker.go: Webhook (finds runs by github_run_id, re-fetches via Backend.GetRun), ApplyLifecycle (status + event), Reconcile (polls queued/running runs every 30 s).
- internal/core/runbinding.go: attemptRunID(deploymentID, runID, attempt) is the run's primary key, a hash. lockRun creates a run on the first token request with Ref, TriggerEvent, Pipeline (from OIDC), Actor, TriggeringActor (from the API).
- internal/core/firstrun.go: findDeployment(owner, repository, workflow file), case-insensitive owner/repo, live deployments only.
- internal/core/model.go: Run. migrations/002: trigger blocks changes to the run's `agent` snapshot, `budget_micros`, `created_at`.

## What to build

On each `workflow_run` delivery (actions requested, in_progress, completed), using the signed payload (decision: trust it, no API re-fetch needed):
1. Deployment: owner/repo from `repository.full_name`, workflow file = last element of `workflow_run.path` (".github/workflows/x.yml" → "x.yml"). findDeployment; none → outcome `ignored` (archived anyway). Do not create deployments. Record even if the deployment is disabled.
2. Run ID = attemptRunID(deployment.ID, workflow_run.id, workflow_run.run_attempt), so the webhook and the token path converge on the same row (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, then SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, as lockRun does).
3. On create, from the payload: GitHubRunID, RunAttempt, GitHubURL (html_url), TriggerEvent (`event`), Actor (actor.login), TriggeringActor (triggering_actor.login), deployment snapshot and threshold as lockRun does, Status via statusFromGitHub.
   New Run fields (omitempty, missing stays missing): `HeadBranch` (`head_branch`, kept as GitHub gives it: for a tag push it holds the tag name, so do not turn it into a full ref), `HeadSHA`, `GitHubStartedAt` (`run_started_at`), `GitHubCompletedAt` (`updated_at` when status is completed). The PR-linking ticket needs the start/completed times.
   Pipeline from `referenced_workflows[0]`: path = text before the first ".yml@"/".yaml@" (reuse jobWorkflowRef in pipeline.go), Ref = text after "@", SHA = `sha`. Do NOT use the entry's `ref` field: for xpmatteo/agbredo-pipelines@v1 GitHub sent `"ref":"refs/heads/v1"` while v1 is a tag. Several entries (nested reusable workflows): take the first, as the design doc's Limits already accept.
4. Each delivery updates status and adds the github.workflow_run event, as ApplyLifecycle does now. A finished status is never reopened (Transition).
5. Token path (lockRun): when the run already exists because a webhook created it, OIDC is the more exact source: set Ref, TriggerEvent and Pipeline from OIDC, and Actor/TriggeringActor if empty. This is the only change to lockRun.
6. Replace the API re-fetch in Webhook with the payload. Reconcile keeps polling queued/running runs via GetRunAttempt (it covers lost deliveries) and will now include webhook-created runs.
7. Runs triggered by `pull_request` are recorded too (recording only; they still get no token).

Dashboard: runs without telemetry show "Unavailable" for cost (runCost already does this when EstimatedCostAvailable is false). On the run page, add Head branch / Head SHA / GitHub start and completion; say "No telemetry received" where agent runs would be. runRef: prefer Ref, then HeadBranch.

## Docs

docs/10-design.md Flow and the "registered only when a token is requested" sentence, Data (runs), Limits. docs/00-glossary.md Run row ("Code today"). docs/20-routes.md webhook section.

## How to check

- Tests (DB): webhook for a known deployment with no run creates the run with the fields above; a later token request finds the same run and sets OIDC fields; disabled deployment is recorded; unknown workflow is ignored; deleted deployment is ignored; completed is not reopened; pipeline from referenced_workflows ignores the bogus `ref`.
- After deploy: a skipped audit run in xpmatteo/rpg-interpreter shows up on /runs with status completed and no telemetry.

## Open questions for Matt

None known.

comments.text: From ag-o6z.1 review: (1) X-GitHub-Event header is not signed; a replayed signed body could be relabelled with another event name. When reading facts from the payload, check that its shape matches the event (e.g. workflow_run object present for event workflow_run). (2) webhook_deliveries dedupes per delivery, not per run: a delivery is handled once overall. Fine while one workflow_run delivery maps to one run; keep in mind if one delivery updates several records.

Built on branch ag-o6z.2/runs-from-webhooks, commit ea61db1 (not merged, not pushed). No migration: new Run JSON fields head_branch, head_sha (omitempty), github_started_at, github_completed_at (omitzero). Webhook path (core.Service.Webhook) now takes core.WorkflowRun parsed from the signed payload by github.ParseWorkflowRunEvent, which checks the shape (action requested/in_progress/completed, workflow_run with id, run_attempt, path, status, and workflow_run.repository == repository, case-insensitive); bad shape -> 400, indexed failed. One tx per delivery: index row 'handled', findDeployment (live, maybe disabled), INSERT run ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING with attemptRunID, then SELECT ... FOR UPDATE ORDER BY id of all runs with that github_run_id+attempt (so runs of deleted deployments that already exist are still updated), applyWorkflowRun on each (status, event, fill-if-missing). Poll (ApplyLifecycle) uses the same applyWorkflowRun, so it also fills the new fields. Backend.GetRun removed. TRUST FINDING: old lockRun skipped the enabled/not-deleted check whenever a run row existed, so a webhook-created run of a disabled deployment would have got a token. Fixed: the check is skipped only if the run already has a run_tokens row (tokens are never deleted). Old rule kept: a run with a token keeps getting tokens when disabled. The first token (no run_tokens row, checked again under FOR UPDATE) sets Ref, TriggerEvent, Pipeline from OIDC and Actor/TriggeringActor if empty. statusFromGitHub: requested/queued/pending/waiting -> queued (was running). Pipeline from referenced_workflows[0].path via jobWorkflowRef; ref is as written (v1), so the deployment page groups webhook-only runs (v1) apart from token runs (refs/tags/v1) - documented in Limits. Dashboard: head branch, head SHA, GitHub start/completion, 'No telemetry received'; runRef = Ref, then HeadBranch, then deployment copy. Docs: design (Flow 5-7, new 'Runs from webhooks' section, Data runs, Trust webhooks, Limits), glossary (Pipeline, Version, Run, Configuration), routes (webhook, run page). Tests: github/webhook_test.go (parse + shape), core/webhookrun_test.go (create with fields, token after webhook sets OIDC, webhook fills token run, webhook+token race keeps one run, recording grants nothing on both routes, deleted deployment, poll finishes a webhook run), PipelineOfRun, updated delivery-index tests (failures now injected with a trigger on runs), webapi webhook test, web run page tests. make test passes with DB tests running.

Review fixes in commit b4895af: skipped/neutral -> completed; action_required -> stays queued, no completion time (approval moves it on); PipelineVersions groups by ref without refs/tags/ or refs/heads/ (SHA still in key), stored refs unchanged; pull_request runs record no pipeline from referenced_workflows; runRef no longer falls back to HeadBranch; docs: status mapping, Trust replay with new delivery ID, Limits on deployment copy at first webhook, stale installation and action_required polling; Pipeline type comment and glossary. New tests: TestDatabaseWebhookStatusFromConclusions, TestPipelineVersionsGroupsShortAndFullRefs, pull_request pipeline nil, run page head branch not as ref. make test passes.

Second review fixes in commit c9961f4: action_required runs get Run.AwaitingApproval (JSON awaiting_approval, omitempty), recomputed on every webhook/poll state (queued && action_required). Reconcile skips them (document->>'awaiting_approval' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'); approval webhook clears it and polling resumes. Chose a run field over an events-table subquery so the poll and the dashboard share one rule; dashboard leaves them out of Active and labels them 'Waiting for approval'. Fork guard: no pipeline for any event starting with pull_request except pull_request_target. Tests: approval run not polled then followed after approval; pull_request_review/_comment no pipeline, pull_request_target keeps it; web label and Active count. Docs updated. make test passes.

title: Record every run of a live deployment from workflow_run webhooks, with or without telemetry
